character_neurosis.pdf.title: Character and Neurosis: An Integrative View
character_neurosis.pdf.author: Claudio Naranjo
character_neurosis.pdf.about: Compares the enneagram of personality types with other psychological character typing systems and discusses of the origins of each type.

dramatis_personae.pdf.title: Dramatis personae: Eneatipos, cine y literatura
dramatis_personae.pdf.author: Claudio Naranjo
dramatis_personae.pdf.about: Dramatis personae is a book by psychiatrist Claudio Naranjo that maps the 27 sub-types of the Enneagram personality system using famous characters from cinema and literature.

E1.pdf.title: Psychology of Enneatypes — Enneatype 1
E1.pdf.author: Claudio Naranjo
E1.pdf.about: Psychology of Enneatypes — Enneatype 1. Enneagram Type 1 — Anger/Wrath. The volume examines the conservation, sexual, and social subtypes of Enneatype 1.
